experiences.title: CREATE-UH Hardware Design Lab
experiences.summary: I help keep the CREATE-UH program running smoothly while supporting students through practical hardware work.

highlights: Run and support hands-on hardware lab sessions
Help students debug circuits and soldering work
Hosted the first soldering workshop in program history
Support the new ECE-focused lab as senior lab assistant
